{{Ophiuchus}}
Ophiuchus 28 is the 364th day of the year in the [[Gaian calendar]]. It is the 28th day of Ophiuchus, and it is a Sunday. It corresponds to ISO week 52, weekday 7.

Its informal Japanese name is 13宮28日.

On this day, [[Gaiad chapter 364|Chapter 364]] of the [[Gaiad]] is read.

To see structured data on this date see {{q|Q152383}}.
